data.name: Perfect Weapon
data.detailed_description:
Captured and imprisoned in a brutal alien facility, Kane has only one chance to survive: fight.

In Perfect Weapon, players enter a dangerous intergalactic prison where warriors from across the universe are forced into deadly combat. As Kane, you must battle your way through a series of brutal arena fights against powerful alien opponents, each with their own fighting styles and deadly abilities.

Using a variety of martial arts techniques, special attacks, and strategic movement, you must defeat every challenger standing between you and freedom.

Every fight is a test of skill and survival. Only the strongest warrior will escape.

Do you have what it takes to become the Perfect Weapon?

Key Features

🥊 Fast-Paced Arena Combat
Fight in intense one-on-one battles against powerful alien opponents.

👽 Intergalactic Fighters
Face a variety of extraterrestrial enemies, each with unique fighting styles.

⚡ Special Moves and Combos
Master martial arts techniques and devastating attacks to defeat your rivals.

🏟 3D Arena Battles
Move freely within arenas and use positioning to gain the advantage.

🕹 Classic 90s Fighting Experience
A retro action game inspired by the early era of 3D combat games.
